title: RF Online Next launches its first 500-person siege, with marketplace taxes up for grabs
summary: The prize for winning RF Online Next’s first siege includes a pot of marketplace tax, which is a very medieval way to run a sci-fi MMORPG. Netmarble’s latest update is now live, with the Albern Fortress siege as its centrepiece and a new server, Vera, opening tomorrow. Albern Fortress is the first Outer Planet siege, and its opening battle takes place on October 31st. Up to ten guilds and 500 people fight at once, and whoever holds the Control Bridge for 20 minutes wins.  ... [MORE]

title: Astrae Oratio gets roaring approval from players after recent closed beta test
summary: It's rare for us to cover the results of a closed beta, and usually for good reason. It's a time when devs are still ironing out the kinks, and that means there are usually a few teething issues. But sometimes, things are so well received they can't help but crow about them, as Astrae Oratio's 93% approval rate shows. What that means is that, according to NCsoft, 93% of polled players in the closed beta for their upcoming magic-themed ARPG said they'd be playing on the official launch. 86% came away with an overall positive impression, and 80% singled out the world and its cast for praise. In total, players logged a combined playtime of over 80,000 hours in Astrae Oratio. ... [MORE]

title: Cut the Rope Remastered brings the classic puzzler to iOS and Android this winter
summary: For anyone who was a youngster in the early 2010s, a trip to the local Apple Store wasn't complete without getting your grubby fingers all over the iPads and iPhones to play the latest mobile games. Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride and, of course, Cut the Rope, all made us promise that this Christmas we'd finally get that smartphone we'd been wishing for. So, it seems only fitting that December 3rd will see the return of at least one of those classics, as Cut the Rope Remastered comes to iOS and Android! Previously only available via Apple Arcade, it's already racked up a whopping 50 million installs, and now will be available as a one-time purchase with a special pre-registration discount. ... title: Sanrio Kawaii Me Live! opens pre-reg for the new mascot rhythm game
summary: The Sanrio brand is probably one of the most widespread on the planet; characters like Badtz Maro, My Melody, and of course, Hello Kitty, have all made their mark worldwide. So, it's no surprise Sanrio are pursuing their own games, as Sanrio Kawaii Me Live! hits pre-registration on iOS and Android. title: Once Human lets you take to the seas in its Isles of Abyss update, out now
summary: What is it with this week and the ocean? Not only have we had Death in the Water 2 make its iOS debut, but we've also had Disney Dreamlight Valley's Keepsake Sea expansion get a major showcase! And now, in survival-shooter Once Human, you can take to the waves as part of its Isles of Abyss update! The headlining addition in Isles of Abyss is that of new naval options that allow you to make your way from simple sail-powered rafts all the way to massive battleships as you progress along a nautical tech tree. And you'll need that firepower as you explore five new hazard zones packed with danger and obstacles you'll need to tackle in order to unlock ways to resist them. ... [MORE]

title: Broken Ranks is a gritty MMORPG that plunges you into turn-based combat with 10 seconds to outsmart your enemy, now available on Android
summary: Whitemoon Games has unleashed a dose of old-school dark fantasy on mobile with Broken Ranks, an isometric MMORPG now available for Android. Blending the party-based adventuring of Baldur's Gate with tactical inspiration from Heroes of Might & Magic and Disciples, this free-to-play MMORPG looks to scratch that classic fantasy itch - and lop off a few limbs in the process! There's plenty of grim storytelling to get stuck into, too, with narrative-driven quests taking you across war-torn lands and into the unfortunate lives of the locals caught up in the chaos. You'll also have a classic roster of classes to choose from, with a mix of damage-dealers, archers, mages, and, the seldom seen but always appreciated, debuffer. ... [MORE]

title: Rojak Rush turns Malaysian salad ingredients into a one-thumb Survivors-like RPG
summary: A hero called Youtiao and another called Nanas sounds like a shopping list, and pretty much is one. Rojak is the Malaysian and Singaporean fruit-and-veg salad, and all six of the Kampong Rojak crew in Rojak Rush are named after what goes into it. It’s a one-thumb survivors RPG, out now on iOS. You drag to move, and your hero does the fighting on its own against swarms of Veilbound creatures. Every level-up deals three cards. You pick new powers, stack them and evolve them into something much bigger. Kinda what Vampire Survivors did. Then there are pets, a 186 of them, summoned with moon charms, and up to three fight beside you with a skill each. The odds for every pet are shown before you spend, and ten summons in a row always include an Epic or better. ... [MORE]

title: Death in the Water 2 gives you the 'privilege' of surviving deep-sea horror on iOS
summary: I have a fear of deep water. If you asked me to either run nude, covered in barbecue sauce, through a pack of hungry zombie-werewolves-vampires, or be dropped into the middle of the deep sea where I can't see the bottom for five minutes, I'm getting my running shoes on. All of which is to say that Death in the Water 2 is my perfect nightmare as it arrives on iOS. Death in the Water 2 sees you taking on the role of a deep-sea diving bounty hunter exploring Blackwater Bay. This mysterious patch of sea is infamous for divers, ships and even planes meeting mysterious ends. And it's your job to dive in and explore, to find out exactly what lurks beneath. Lucky you. ... [MORE]

title: Clash Royale: The Grand Arena blazes past Kickstarter goal in under an hour
summary: It seems that we'll soon be seeing Clash Royale join Clash of Clans on the tabletop, as The Grand Arena, the upcoming spinoff from publisher Maestro Media in collaboration with Supercell, has blazed past its Kickstarter goal. Now at $82,000, more than three times the original goal, it seems we'll soon be seeing The Grand Arena grace stores. If you're not familiar, Maestro Media previously worked with Supercell to bring Clash of Clans: The Epic Raid to dining-room tables the world over. It translated the hit RTS into a multiplayer board game that featured the same base-building and base-raiding action of the original. Seemingly, The Epic Raid was successful enough to warrant further collaborations between the two companies. ... [MORE]

title: Hearthstone brings on the Old Gods for you to command in Reign of the Black Empire
summary: Like any good fantasy universe, World of Warcraft has a wealth of created history and worldbuilding to draw from. And there's plenty of that in Hearthstone, especially with the launch of their most eldritch expansion yet, Reign of the Black Empire and its introduction of the terrifying Old Gods! title: Scoops Classic brings the mobile stacking puzzler back to iOS and Android
summary: It seems that this week is something of a return for mobile games that have slipped into the past. We've had FingerLaserX bring back its exciting mix of neon-rich bullet hell action, and now Scoops Classic offers a throwback physics puzzler from the folks at NimbleBit! Believe me, I do mean throwback, as Scoops Classic makes use of the sadly often-overlooked motion controls on your phone. You tilt your device to make scoops of ice cream land on top of each other, and work to build a tower of sugar all the way to the stars! But don't worry, players used to more modern setups can also use touch controls. ... [MORE]

summary: The four depths in Gravemark are named after Dante’s Inferno, which means the bottom floor of a free-to-play hack-and-slash is now Judecca, home of a seasonal leaderboard. title: Subway Loop brings The Exit 8-style anomaly horror to iPhone
summary: Android owners aren’t having a great day. Subway Loop is the third game I’ve written up today that launched on iPhone first, though this one is out now on iOS and has at least promised Android a seat soon. title: Accelebot turns your iPhone into a tilt-controlled platformer you can play one-handed
summary: You don’t get a single button in Accelebot. No d-pad, no jump icon parked in the corner, nothing. You tilt your iPhone to move, tap anywhere on the screen to jump, and that’s the whole control scheme, playable one-handed in portrait. It’s a 2D platformer, and it’s out now on the App Store. It comes from solo developer Robert Perez. The levels are large, with secrets tucked away for anyone who goes poking around. The level select screen keeps track of which ones you’ve found. Each level also logs your total time, so you can chase your own best or the developer’s, and there’s a quick menu for switching off the sound effects and music without leaving a level. Wearable cosmetics are in there too. ... [MORE]

title: Pokémon TCG Pocket announces the debut of Dual-type cards in new Dual Fusion expansion
summary: Most trading card games thrive on predictability, where your knowledge of the game and your opponent's hand is a key strategic strength. For example, in Pokémon, you know certain types are strong against others, like Electric against Water. But Pokémon TCG Pocket is upsetting that paradigm of predictability with the debut of dual-type cards in their upcoming Dual Fusion expansion, which arrives on October 29th! Now, we all know that in Pokémon you have different 'types', be that Fighting, Fire or Metal. And it's the rock-paper-scissors at the centre of these different card types that forms the basis of the game. But dual-type cards boast two instead, and are guaranteed to switch things up in the new Dual Fusion expansion. ... [MORE]

title: Momolitos brings 600 creatures to iOS, with food deciding what they become
summary: Drawing 600 of anything sounds like a lot. Drawing 600 creatures, and then programming the thing they live in, is what Goca, the solo developer behind Goca Games, has done with Momolitos, and I’d like to think there’s a sketchbook somewhere that’s just eyes and tails. Momolitos launches on iOS this week, alongside Switch and Steam, and what you feed your creatures decides what they turn into. You start with an egg, raise whatever hatches, and head out into a handful of colourful worlds looking for ingredients. Bring them back, try a new food, see what happens. Some forms are cute, others apparently go somewhere much stranger. ... [MORE]

title: FingerLaserX is out now, taking you back to a simpler time on mobile with action-packed gameplay
summary: Nowadays, mobile plays to everything from simple, casual puzzlers to sprawling open worlds full of fantasy and adventure. But turn the clock back to 2012, and you'll find a very different scene, full of smaller, quirkier entries. And that is precisely the world that FingerLaserX is a throwback to. FingerLaserX may seem familiar, and that's because it is. First launched back in 2012, this simple neon bullet hell had you sliding your finger to bring down attacking enemy spaceships. Flashy and fast-paced, it proved to be a major hit on mobile and even briefly dethroned YouTube on Taiwan's app store charts during a free promotion. ... [MORE]

title: Old School RuneScape's hardest raid yet, The Fractured Archive, comes to mobile
summary: It's been a couple of weeks now since I attended RuneFest 2026. And for a first-time visitor and only a once-or-twice RuneScape player, it succeeded in getting me hyped for what was coming to the hit MMO. Now, fans of Old School RuneScape can look forward to the hardest raid yet, The Fractured Archive. The Fractured Archive follows on from the quest While Guthix Sleeps, and sees you and the allies you've gained in your journey so far heading deep into the Fractured Archive. This enormous vault contains not just forbidden knowledge, but plenty of powerful artefacts that can't fall into the wrong hands. ... [MORE]

title: The House of Tesla has you unlocking the secrets of the enigmatic scientist, out now
summary: Blue Brain Games has offered plenty of ways to challenge even the most devoted puzzle fans. Most recently, it was unravelling the works of famed Renaissance scientist Leonardo Da Vinci. Now, you'll finally step into The House of Tesla as the new 3D puzzler arrives on iOS and Android today! The House of Tesla follows a similar format to Blue Brain Games' hit trilogy, House of Da Vinci. You'll explore the sprawling Wardenclyffe facility, solving puzzles in first-person and uncovering the mystery of the rise and fall of one of Tesla's most ambitious dreams in his pursuit of the power of electricity. ... [MORE]
